name: labyrinth-vault
description: An airgapped signing device for Bitcoin and Monero. Keys are made and signatures are given on a phone that never touches a network; QR codes are the only wire.

scripts.test: npm run build:bundle && vitest run && npm run swift:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.build:bundle: node scripts/build-bundle.mjs && node scripts/emit-swift-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/make-icons.mjs
